name: fitledger-starter
description: FitLedger -- the RainDB starter: a deployable, white-labelable workout + journal SaaS. A TypeScript Lightning bolt server (@raindb/bolt-sdk + @raindb/agent) + Vite/React client. Clone it, run scripts/setup.sh, and you have a live app on RainDB. No database, no ORM, no Redis, no message broker -- the substrate is the backend.
